items.title: 古驰部分经典款涨价5%-8%，涨价与降价并行的分裂定价
items.summary: Sina Finance market brief reports Gucci has raised prices roughly 5-8% on select classic handbags (GG Marmont, Dionysus) and footwear in mainland China stores and online this Sept-Oct, even as other lines were cut up to 40% weeks earlier; cites rising material/labor costs and brand positioning as stated rationale, and notes some consumers are rushing to buy before further hikes while others are shifting to secondhand or competitor brands.

items.source: Sina Hong Kong stocks hourly brief (k.sina.com.cn)
items.title: 古驰部分商品降幅逼近30%，软奢定价模型需重估
items.summary: Hourly HK-stocks/fashion news digest flags that select Gucci merchandise has seen discounts approaching 30%, framing it within a broader argument that 'soft luxury' (accessible, aspirational tier) brands need to rethink pricing models as the old 'always raise, never cut' rule breaks down across the sector.

items.title: グッチ ゲスト、デムナ流スノッブを体現するセンシュアルスタイル
items.summary: WWD Japan street-style coverage of Gucci's Milan S/S 2027 show guests describes tight silhouettes, exposed lingerie/bra tops, deep slits, all-black looks, over-10cm stilettos and Horsebit hardware as embodying Demna's 'snobbish' aesthetic direction for the house; a straightforward fashion-desk report with no reader reaction included.

items.source: Weibo (古驰国内和国外的价差 FAQ series)
items.title: 古驰国内和国外的价格差异会影响其市场份额吗？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-FAQ thread discusses whether narrowing China-vs-overseas price gaps (after Sept discounts) will shift market share back toward domestic purchases from daigou/overseas buying, with top replies split between welcoming the narrower gap and distrust that discount pricing will be sustained.

items.source: Weibo (古驰包二手能卖多少钱 FAQ series)
items.title: 古驰包二手能卖多少钱？专柜降价40%后二手行情全解析
items.summary: Weibo resale-advice thread reports Gucci's secondhand retention rate sits in the mid-to-low tier among luxury brands (roughly 30-50% of original price for most styles, better for classics like Dionysus/Horsebit 1955 at 58-68%), and states the September in-store discount of up to 40% has directly pressured secondhand resale values further; commenters debate whether to sell now or wait.

items.title: 싱글벙글 명품 브랜드 구찌 근황
items.summary: Popular DC Inside real-time-best board thread reposting SBS coverage of Gucci's new China-made 'Drip' sneakers, captioned that revenue has halved so the brand is cutting costs by 'selling out to China'; top comments mock the brand's decline and question whether the origin-based luxury premium still holds. Still actively drawing traffic as of this week per view count.

items.title: 구찌, 2026 가을-겨울 아이웨어 컬렉션… 감각적 포트레이트 눈길
items.summary: Korean fashion trade outlet covers Gucci's F/W 2026 eyewear campaign, a portrait-style series of individuals shown in reflective solo moments, highlighting a black acetate Double-G frame and round black sunglasses with Horsebit temple detail; standard campaign-coverage piece with no critical framing.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？创意总监换人、美妆易主、冠名F1，三大变革全解读
items.summary: Weibo explainer thread rounds up Gucci's three concurrent 2026 shake-ups -- Demna as creative director, Gucci Beauty's July handover to L'Oreal operations, and the F1 Alpine 'Gucci Racing' title sponsorship from 2027 -- framing the brand as mid-transformation; reader comments show curiosity about the F1 tie-up mixed with skepticism that a sponsorship fixes underlying sales declines.
